name: head
description: An adult head (the BigBrain FDG phantom's 511 keV attenuation map, Belzunce 2018, Zenodo 8045458) at 230 MeV on Bergen's DTC: 270 x 165 mm, 41 layers. Not yet run in full: about 5 to 6 h on 20 cores. Entries from a front tracker until the single-sided entry model is fitted for this beam and phantom.
